A0_A1.title: Kind & Friendly Friend
A0_A1.visualDescription: Smiling young person holding a warm cup of cocoa.

pages.bio: I am kind and polite. I say 'please' and 'thank you'. I like helping my friends and neighbors. I smile at people on the street. I remember birthdays and bring sweet cookies to my friends.

A0_A1.opener: Hello my friend! How are you today?
A0_A1.prompt: What does a kind person do? Describe 2 simple actions.

A2.title: Organized & Reliable (Sophia)
A2.visualDescription: Focused young woman checking off tasks in a paper planner at her clean desk.

pages.bio: I am Sophia. I am very organized, punctual, and reliable. I never arrive late because I respect time. I use a daily planner to write my tasks, prepare my clothes the night before, and keep my desk clean.

A2.opener: Hi! Do you like to plan your week ahead or do you make spontaneous decisions?
A2.prompt: Why is reliability an important trait in friendship? Give an example.

B1.title: Empathetic & Intuitive (Daniel)
B1.visualDescription: Warm-hearted man listening intently during a conversation at a quiet coffee shop.

pages.bio: I'm Daniel, a 28-year-old counselor who values high emotional intelligence, active listening, and sincere empathy in personal relationships. Friends frequently seek my advice when they encounter difficult challenges because I offer non-judgmental support and honest feedback.

B1.opener: Hello! Do you consider yourself more guided by logical analysis or emotional intuition when making choices?
B1.prompt: Explain how emotional intelligence helps resolve interpersonal conflicts between friends.

B2.title: Visionary & Resilient (Helena)
B2.visualDescription: Determined female executive standing on a terrace overlooking the city skyline.

pages.bio: I'm Helena, 32. My character is anchored by strategic foresight, unflinching resilience during crises, and an unwavering commitment to empowering my team. I view setbacks not as failures, but as invaluable empirical data for growth, driving innovation through calculated risk-taking and radical transparency.

B2.opener: Greetings! What fundamental leadership qualities distinguish transformational visionaries from conventional managers?
B2.prompt: Differentiate between transactional management and transformative resilient leadership in modern organizations.
